The plate is about 350 px wide in the image. If it is a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, that gives about 0.074 cm per px.

The food is a piece of meat, which looks like steak or a pork chop. It measures about 130 px by 100 px, or roughly 9.5 by 7 cm. It looks fairly thin, maybe 1.5 cm, so I estimate about 80-100 g.

There are also about 6 roasted potato pieces, each about 2.5-3 cm. Each weighs roughly 20-25 g, so together they come to about 130 g.

Meat at about 100 g cooked is roughly 200 kcal. The roasted potatoes are about 150 kcal per 100 g, so about 130 g gives roughly 200 kcal, including the oil they were roasted in.

That puts the total at about 230 g and 400 kcal.
